manual.prompt: A density is $f(x)=12x^{2}(1-x)$ for $0\le x\le1$. Find the mode and the mean.

manual.title: Batteries lasting beyond four hundred forty five hours
manual.prompt: Battery lives are normal with mean $400$ h and standard deviation $30$ h. Find the probability a battery lasts more than $445$ h, and the expected number of such batteries in a batch of $2000$.

manual.title: Identifying unusual results by z score
manual.prompt: Reaction times have mean $250$ ms and standard deviation $20$ ms. Calculate the $z$-scores of $205$ ms and $268$ ms and decide which, if either, is unusual (beyond $2$ standard deviations).

manual.title: Mean of a quadratic density on one to three
manual.prompt: Show that $f(x)=\tfrac3{26}x^{2}$ for $1\le x\le3$ is a probability density function, and find $E(X)$.

manual.title: Comparing a sprinter and a long jumper
manual.prompt: A sprinter runs $10.4$ s (event mean $10.8$, sd $0.2$) and a long jumper jumps $7.9$ m (event mean $7.5$, sd $0.25$). Using $z$-scores, who performed better relative to their event? Note that lower times are better.

manual.title: Commutes longer than forty minutes over a working year
manual.prompt: Commute times are normal with mean $30$ min and standard deviation $6$ min. Find the probability a commute exceeds $40$ min, and the expected number of such days in $200$ working days.

diagram.alt: Graph drawn on x and y axes; 2 plotted lines, curves or sets of points are drawn; a region is shaded. Read the question for what it asks.

manual.title: Variance of a half x density on zero to two
manual.prompt: A density is $f(x)=\tfrac x2$ for $0\le x\le2$. Find $E(X)$ and $\mathrm{Var}(X)$.

manual.title: Mean from a lower tail probability
manual.prompt: A normal variable has standard deviation $5$ and $P(X<40)=0.0228$. Find its mean.

manual.title: Median and mode of a symmetric quadratic density
manual.prompt: A density is $f(x)=\tfrac34x(2-x)$ for $0\le x\le2$. Find the mode and median, using symmetry for the median.
